description: A man in a dark coat and bow tie stands on porch steps, reading aloud from a yellowed sheet of paper. Around him, a crowd of Black men, women and children in 19th-century work clothes and headwraps listens intently. An elderly man with a cane sits at lower right. Behind them are brick walls and columns in a shaded, dim setting. The style is an oil-painting look, with no visible text, frame or graphic content.
